items: 【Latest Android 14.0 OS】Android tablet is equipped with a Unisoc T606 octa-core processor, ensuring a smoother experience and faster multitasking. Running on the latest Android 14 operating system, it offers enhanced privacy, security features, and a user-friendly interface. Android tablet 10 inch with GMS certification , effortlessly download popular apps like TikTok, YouTube, Netflix, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, etc

【Dual 4G LTE+5G WiFi】2024 newest Android tablet supports dual nano SIM cards with 4G/3G/2G connectivity ensures high-quality communication. Enjoy seamless work, stay in touch with family, and connect with friends anytime and anywhere. Tablet features built-in Bluetooth 5.0 and dual-band 5G/2.4G WiFi, ensures seamless connectivity. 2 in 1 tablet includes a Bluetooth keyboard, effortlessly transforming it into a portable laptop for easy work mode switching. [Please Note: Sim card is not included]

【128GB+14GB/1TB Expansion】10 inch tablet comes with 128GB ROM and 14GB RAM (8GB +6GB expandable), and supports up to 1TB of expanded storage. Android 14 tablet provides ample space to store all your files, photos, music, videos, e-books, games, and online courses, meeting both daily and office needs

【Immersive Audio and VIsual Experience】Tablet features a 10.1" FHD Incell display, offering detailed character processing and realistic images, making movies and games leap off the screen with exceptional clarity and richness. The tablet's also has dual speakers that provide immersive, clear, and powerful sound for a superior audio-visual experience

【8000mAh Battery + 21MP Camera】Android 14 tablet is equipped with an 8000mAh large battery, providing over 480 hours of standby time, up to 12 hours of web browsing, 10 hours of video playback, and 7 hours of gaming. Enjoy extended use without constant recharging. 10.1 inch tablet PC features a 13MP rear camera and an 8MP front camera, delivering excellent video recording and photo-taking experiences. It's perfect for video calls and video conferencing

【Multifunctional 2-in-1 Tablet】Android tablets boasts a slim and lightweight design, with a bezel thickness of just 7mm and a weight of only 450g, making it highly portable. Package Includes: 1 x kimlok Tablet, 1 x Tablet Case, 1 x Bluetooth Keyboard, 1 x Wireless Mouse, 1 x Touch Pen, 1 x Screen Protector, 1 x OTG Adapter, 1 x Type-C Cable, 1 x Charger, 1 x SD Card Tray Eject Pin, 1 x User Manual
